fusions.name: Calm Dispatch
fusions.desc: Fires a round at an enemy up to 9 tiles away that deals 22 water damage, rising to 1.2 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Soaked] for 6 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Decoy Calls
fusions.desc: Fires a scatter of rounds around you that deals 6 water damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 20% chance to turn each one against its allies for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Shake It Off
fusions.desc: Removes 2 conditions from you, and your movement speed rises 15% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Cool Under Fire
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, your next strike gains 30% critical hit chance. Once every 30 seconds.
